commands.command:
set -eu
if ! getent group inventory-readers >/dev/null; then groupadd --system inventory-readers; fi
if ! getent passwd inventorysvc >/dev/null; then useradd --system --no-create-home --home-dir /nonexistent --shell /usr/sbin/nologin --gid inventory-readers inventorysvc; fi
chown -R inventorysvc:inventory-readers /srv/inventory
find /srv/inventory -xdev -type d -exec chmod 0750 {} +
find /srv/inventory -xdev -type f -exec chmod 0640 {} +
printf '%s\n' 'repair-applied'
getent passwd inventorysvc
getent group inventory-readers
find /srv/inventory -xdev -printf '%y|%u:%g|%m|%s|%p\n' | sort

set -eu
reader_gid=$(getent group inventory-readers | cut -d: -f3)
svc_uid=$(id -u inventorysvc)
printf 'boot_id=%s\n' "$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)"
printf 'system_state=%s\n' "$(systemctl is-system-running 2>/dev/null || true)"
printf '%s\n' '--- final metadata ---'
find /srv/inventory -xdev -printf '%y|%u:%g|%m|%s|%p\n' | sort
printf '%s\n' '--- owner read proof ---'
setpriv --reuid="$svc_uid" --regid="$reader_gid" --clear-groups sha256sum /srv/inventory/data/config.json /srv/inventory/data/records.csv
printf '%s\n' '--- group read proof ---'
setpriv --reuid=65534 --regid="$reader_gid" --clear-groups sha256sum /srv/inventory/data/config.json /srv/inventory/data/records.csv
printf '%s\n' '--- other-user denial proof ---'
if setpriv --reuid=65534 --regid=65534 --clear-groups sh -c 'test -r /srv/inventory/data/config.json || test -r /srv/inventory/data/records.csv || test -x /srv/inventory'; then echo 'ERROR: other user retained access'; exit 1; else echo 'other-user read/traverse access denied'; fi
printf '%s\n' '--- exact hashes after repair ---'
sha256sum /srv/inventory/data/config.json /srv/inventory/data/records.csv | sort
